links.outcome: AI-report agreement by clinical indication and share of discordance
links.effect: Agreement 98.6% screening, 38.3% oncologic, 32.6% inpatient/emergency; inpatient/emergency contributed 76.1% of discordance; 44.2% of exams AI positive/report negative
links.quote: Agreement was 98.6% for screening, 38.3% for oncologic, and 32.6% for inpatient/emergency examinations, which contributed 76.1% of discordance.

links.outcome: Nodules present in AI-negative examinations on image review
links.effect: 196 of 198 (99.0%) AI-negative/report-positive exams had an unmarked nodule >3 mm, 45 (23.0%) >6 mm; review-adjusted sensitivity 81.2%
links.quote: On image review, 291 of 298 (97.7%) AI-positive/report-negative examinations contained only non-nodule structures, and 196 of 198 (99.0%) AI-negative/report-positive examinations contained an unmarked nodule larger than 3 mm, 45 of them (23.0%) larger than 6 mm.

links.effect: Of reviewed AI-negative/report-positive examinations, 196 of 198 (99.0%) contained an unmarked nodule larger than 3 mm; 45 of them (23.0%) were larger than 6 mm.
links.quote: On image review, 291 of 298 (97.7%) AI-positive/report-negative examinations contained only non-nodule structures, and 196 of 198 (99.0%) AI-negative/report-positive examinations contained an unmarked nodule larger than 3 mm, 45 of them (23.0%) larger than 6 mm.

links.outcome: Postdeployment examination-level diagnostic performance following image review
links.effect: Review-adjusted examination-level sensitivity was 81.2%, specificity 38.2%, and positive predictive value 35.4%.
links.quote: Review-adjusted examination-level sensitivity was 81.2%, specificity 38.2%, and positive predictive value 35.4%.
